:::{#exm-inference}
#### Inference about cholesterol in the WCGS population

The [WCGS](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#sec-wcgs-data)
measured total cholesterol in 3,142 of its 3,154 participants.
Using those measurements to learn about
the distribution of cholesterol among men like the participants,
for example its mean,
and quantifying how uncertain that knowledge is,
is statistical inference.
:::
